subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491). Rule 5's Table 8 note - 'Literal-2 or literal-3 or spaces means one instance of literal-2 or literal-3 or as many spaces as there are characters in literal-2 or literal-3' - is a rule about a literal of ANY width (SR9 caps it at 50), and the fixed-width 1:1 mask model could not carry it, which is why a literal wider than one character was staged loud with COBOL0899. The render is now split in two: Render produces the LOGICAL image, one character per picture SYMBOL, which is the image every editing rule of 13.18.40.5 is written about; Materialize gives each symbol the width 13.18.40.4 GR14 gives it. That is the SAME mechanism the multi-character currency string had to itself (ExpandCurrency/CollapseCurrency, both now deleted), so there is one variable-width pass rather than two, and DeEdit walks the same widths in reverse instead of searching the image for a string. SR12c's default is applied at the specified literal's width ('the space character repeated for the number of characters in' it). MEASURED: the Annex D.24 images, verbatim, plus the alphanumeric-edited IS-form twin PIC XXTXX EDITING T IS "::" -> 'AB::CD' at SIZE 6 (GR14 'es' first sentence), which used to bind SIZE 5.
